title: Local eventual zero sieve before finite etale cover selection
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. On the small etale site $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $G:\mathcal I\to\mathrm{Mod}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ be a diagram of sheaves of modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ a small filtered category and $(H,(c_i))$ a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $U\to X$ be an etale object with quasi-compact underlying scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If $s\in G_i(U)$ has $(c_i)_U(s)=0$, then there exists a covering sieve $S$ of $U$ such that for every arrow $q:V\to U$ in $S$ there exist an index $j$ and a morphism $f:i\to j$ with $G(f)_V(s|_V)=0$. A sieve means an arrow family closed under precomposition; covering is for the small etale topology. No finite subfamily or global separatedness conclusion is part of this assertion.

proof.text: If s is zero use the top sieve and identity transition. Otherwise use [lem-weil-pbc-etale-module-sheaf-nonzero-section-universe] to obtain UnivLE from s. This bounds the affine etale small model and its required limits by the section universe.

Use Mathlib hasSheafifyEssentiallySmallSite on the affine etale site and the one-hypercover-dense affine basis comparison to transport sheafification and WEqualsLocallyBijective to the small etale site. Sheafify the presheaf colimit cocone and compare it to c by coconePointUniqueUpToIso. Check coprojections with sheafifyCocone_ι_app_val. The presheaf comparison is the sheafification unit followed by an isomorphism and is locally injective. Apply equalizerSieve_mem to the representative x of s and zero.

On each arrow in this covering equalizer sieve, coprojection naturality shows the restricted representative is zero. Evaluation preserves the presheaf colimit. The module forgetful functor preserves the filtered colimit via its explicit TypeMax colimit cocone. Apply Concrete.isColimit_exists_of_rep_eq, the module form of [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise], to the restricted section and zero. The witness arrow from i kills the section since the other arrow preserves zero. No finite selection or eventual-zero theorem is used.

mathlib_searches.query: local equality of representatives in a filtered colimit of sheaves on the etale site
a zero image of an etale module sheaf section in a filtered colimit gives a covering sieve of arrows on which the section becomes zero at a later stage
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: etale ring loci, Scheme.zero_of_zero_cover, ringed-space germ vanishing, and SheafOfModules generators. None states local eventual vanishing for this colimit cocone.

25 hits including PresheafOfModules.Sheafify.app_eq_of_isLocallyInjective and Concrete.colimit_rep_eq_zero. These require local injectivity or a sectionwise colimit; neither establishes the covering-sieve assertion for a sheaf colimit.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_section_colimit_local_zero_sieve
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ]
    (U : X.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left]
    (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max v w} Λ))
    (c : Cocone G) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I)
    (s : (G.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U))
    (hs : ((c.ι.app i).hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom s = 0) :
    ∃ S : Sieve U, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology U ∧
      ∀ (V : X.Etale) (q : V ⟶ U), S q →
        ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
          ((G.map f).hom.app (Opposite.op V)).hom
            (((G.obj i).obj.map q.op).hom s) = 0
